title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
why_read: A proposed shared platform for recording and reviewing LLM architecture ideas, aiming to fix the lack of transparency around what works and what fails in model design.
analysis: ArchSpace is pitched as an open venue where researchers can document architecture experiments, including negative results, which labs usually don't publish. It leans on scaling laws to extrapolate small-scale experiment results to larger model sizes, a common industry practice but hard to verify externally. The value depends heavily on adoption; a platform is only as useful as the community that contributes to it. Still, the problem it addresses, wasted effort from unreported failed architecture ideas, is real and worth attention.
